name: Settings
description: Read the settings of the organization the plugin is serving, and change the plugin's own.

capabilities.name: Read settings
capabilities.description: Read the effective value (the organization's own, else the global one) of any setting that is not a secret. Maps to kernel command settings::get.

capabilities.name: Change the plugin's own settings
capabilities.description: Set the organization's value of a setting declared by the plugin itself with [[setting]] (its key starts with the plugin's name and a dot). Only an administrator of the organization may cause it. Maps to kernel command settings::set.
